node.title: N=256 E=34 parity-profile reduction
node.statement: At N=256, folded profile (3,4,0), and V=68, parity of signed chord products reduces the three candidate autocorrelation profiles to (6,7). All six unit-product chords occupy distinct non-diameter circular distance classes, so the four light coefficient positions are circular Sidon. The diameter square mass lies in {0,4,8,12,16,20}, with signed equal-chord cross sum C=-34+D_64/2.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: removes the (9,4,1) and (12,1,2) profiles without computation. The residual (6,7) profile and its equal-chord geometry remain open.
